The decoder stack contains a third sub‑layer that performs multi‑head attention over the output of the encoder, whereas the encoder stack only has self‑attention sub‑layers [AIAYN:3.1:c009].  
In the decoder, the self‑attention sub‑layer is masked to prevent positions from attending to subsequent positions, a restriction that is not applied in the encoder [AIAYN:3.1:c009].  
In encoder‑decoder attention layers, the queries come from the previous decoder layer, while the keys and values (the memory) come from the output of the encoder [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016].
